decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy sits close to the firm's psychiatric expertise, costs little to run, and was promoted to the home page in 2024, so the option's value appears to be resolving favorably.
Senior living counseling has stayed on the home page for two years, needs few resources, and feeds clients into the firm's core eldercare business, so keeping it is cheap and worthwhile.

The sheltered workshop retail shop gained home page prominence in 2024 and builds on existing production, though retail carries somewhat higher carrying costs and the related carpentry offer was already dropped.
Senior meal delivery launched only in 2024, so its uncertainty is unresolved, and its fit with eldercare logistics makes the option worth holding despite moderate operating costs.
